description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_DefinitionCacheFactory, responsible for creating and managing definition cache objects, including registration, creation with decorators, and singleton instance management.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_DefinitionCacheFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating and managing definition cache objects, implementing singleton pattern, decorator registration, and cache creation logic.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes default decorators for the cache factory.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Retrieves a singleton instance of the factory, optionally reinitializing with a provided prototype.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new cache implementation class with a short name.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a cache object based on configuration and applies decorators.

methods.name: addDecorator
methods.description: Registers a decorator to be applied to all new cache objects, either by class name or string identifier.
